title: Vision Plans Contact-Lens Orders: Decision Recording in the Claims System
content:
**Contact-lens orders on the Vision Plans.** Cascade settles a contact-lens order — the contact-lens line of one claim of the enrollment, together with the claim's contact-lens fitting line — and records the decision. The decision fixes each line's remark and the one amount the member pays for the whole order. After it is recorded, the claim's lines show these remarks and the amount on the member's claim history.

**Timing of the member share.** The member share of a contact-lens order is fixed only after no spectacle-lens line of the same person dated in the same benefit period still stands denied as not eligible. A contact-lens order's member share is not worked out until no frame line of the person on an out-of-network claim dated before the order still awaits its first decision.

**Scope.** This rule governs contact-lens orders only. A fitting of an exam visit is settled under the exam-visit rule and a stand-alone fitting under the stand-alone fitting rule. Every other service remains under the general in-network benefit rule. For contact-lens orders, benefit frequency and contacts-in-lieu are counted under this rule, from the latest paid or reimbursed service of the kind under the current enrollment; a reversal counts only when it reverses the one service on that latest date, and a service of the other side counts only when it is dated in the same benefit period, whatever its order. The rules for exam visits, eyeglasses orders, out-of-network claims settled on their glasses part or on their contact-lens part, and stand-alone contact-lens fittings count them the same way. Services paid by another carrier still do not count.

### Recording the decision: `decide_contacts_order_55f7002b`

**Capability.** `decide_contacts_order_55f7002b` records Cascade's decision on the contact-lens order — the contact lenses and any contact-lens fitting of one claim — carrying the claim number. It decides at once the claim's open contact-lens and fitting lines; open lines are lines carrying no remark yet or standing denied as not eligible. The claim's other lines are left as they are. Each line given a remark argument receives that denial remark. Every other line receives the paid remark of its channel: `PAID` at a participating location, `PAID_OON_REIMBURSEMENT` at a provider without a Cascade agreement. The amount is booked on the first line not denied, in the order exam, fitting, contact lenses, lenses, frame (the first line when every line is denied), with no separate amount on the other lines. Every line's decision date is set to today. After the call the claim's lines show these remarks and the amount on the member's claim history.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `decide_contacts_order_55f7002b` and then calls it.

**Parameters**

- `claim_number` — the claim number of the claim, copied character for character from the vision claim lookup, with its letters, digits and hyphens unchanged.
- `member_paid` — the amount the member pays for the whole order, in USD, a non-negative number given to 2 decimal places (cents), rounded half up to the cent.
- `fitting_remark` — the denial remark recorded on the claim's contact-lens fitting line, one of: `DENIED_FREQUENCY` when the line's benefit is not available again under the frequency rule; `DENIED_CONTACTS_IN_LIEU` when the line is left out because the other materials hold the benefit (contacts in lieu of glasses); `DENIED_NOT_COVERED` when the plan carries no benefit for the line; `DENIED_NOT_ELIGIBLE` when the enrollment does not cover the line's date of service; `DENIED_TIMELY_FILING` when the claim reached Cascade after the filing limit; an empty text when the claim carries no such line or the line is paid or reimbursed.
- `contact_lenses_remark` — the denial remark recorded on the claim's contact-lens line, one of: `DENIED_FREQUENCY` when the line's benefit is not available again under the frequency rule; `DENIED_CONTACTS_IN_LIEU` when the line is left out because the other materials hold the benefit (contacts in lieu of glasses); `DENIED_NOT_COVERED` when the plan carries no benefit for the line; `DENIED_NOT_ELIGIBLE` when the enrollment does not cover the line's date of service; `DENIED_TIMELY_FILING` when the claim reached Cascade after the filing limit; an empty text when the claim carries no such line or the line is paid or reimbursed.

A remark argument left as an empty text leaves that line to receive the paid remark of its channel.

**Return.** A dictionary rendered as text means the claim is recorded. It carries `claim_number` (the claim recorded), `member_paid` (the amount booked, USD with 2 decimal places), `lines` (each recorded line's reference number mapped to the remark now recorded) and `adjudicated_date` (today's date, year-month-day). A text starting "No open claim line" means no open line carries that claim number.
